source: adb shell dumpsys media.camera; read-only CameraService metadata inspection
camera_role: front-facing iris sensor, identified by 1920x1088 pixel array
illumination: not requested; no emitter test was run
interpretation: CameraService advertises full-resolution RAW10 and RAW16 outputs for camera 2. This proves the HAL metadata path accepts these stream configurations, not that a capture session can produce a frame or that the RAW10 byte layout matches the offline converter.
next_step: Open only camera 2 with a one-shot RAW10 ImageReader, keep IR off, record Image plane rowStride/pixelStride and capture-result metadata, save one frame only if its scene is a non-person target, and close the camera immediately.
security_status: No change: Android has no iris authenticator, protected iris enrollment, or iris unlock path.
